ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 23).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 13 · failed · daily cycle day 23).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): topping. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.
entry.text_zh: 动量已掉头向下且失守 10 日均线——减仓或收紧止损。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 23 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 23 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 13 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 23 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量开始上翘；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）（投资者周期第 13 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 23 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-10), switching from UPTREND. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-10），自上涨趋势切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-67）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Steris plc is an American-Irish-based medical equipment company specializing in sterilization and surgical products for the US healthcare system. Steris is operationally headquartered in Mentor, Ohio, and has been legally registered in Dublin, Ireland, for tax purposes since 2018.
profile.description_zh: Steris plc是一家基于美国-爱尔兰的医疗设备公司，专注于为美国医疗系统提供灭菌和外科产品。Steris运营总部位于俄亥俄州门托，自2018年起因税务目的在爱尔兰都柏林注册。
